response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph beginning “Tukiwa waaminifu…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“many, if not most, of the ‘stories’”","suggested_fix":"Replace “nyingi, kama si nyingi zaidi” with “nyingi, kama si nyingi kati ya zote” or another phrasing meaning “many, if not most.”","translation_quote":"“nyingi, kama si nyingi zaidi, za ‘simulizi’”"},{"location":"Paragraph beginning “Kuna maswali tunayoweza…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“Am I being advised to join others in standing up for our ‘rights’?”","suggested_fix":"Change to a question meaning “Am I being advised to join others in standing up for our ‘rights’?”, for example: “Je, ninashauriwa kuungana na wengine kutetea ‘haki’ zetu?”","translation_quote":"“Je, nashauriwe kuungana na wengine kutetea ‘haki’ zetu?”"},{"location":"Paragraph beginning “Kama nilivyosema awali…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“He will NOT allow us to be tempted above that which we are able to bear.”","suggested_fix":"Replace “HATARUHUSU tujaribiwe kupita uwezo wetu wa kustahimili” with a faithful rendering of the source’s promise that God will not allow temptation beyond what we can bear, such as “HATARUHUSU tujaribiwe kupita kiasi tunachoweza kustahimili.”","translation_quote":"“HATARUHUSU tujaribiwe kupita uwezo wetu wa kustahimili.”"},{"location":"Paragraph beginning “John S. na Maria…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“John S. and Maria (Horning) Kurtz were my great, great grandparents.”","suggested_fix":"Change “babu na bibi wa babu yangu” to “babu na bibi wa babu/bibi zangu wa vizazi viwili vilivyopita” or an equivalent conveying “great-great-grandparents.”","translation_quote":"“walikuwa babu na bibi wa babu yangu.”"}],"passed":false,"score":86}
